title: Accelerating Gemma 4: faster inference with multi-token prediction drafters
summary: Google Blog announcing a technique to accelerate Gemma 4 inference using multi-token prediction drafters, which predicts multiple tokens simultaneously instead of traditional autoregressive sequential decoding, significantly reducing inference latency.
problem_solved: Addresses the computational bottleneck of slow autoregressive token-by-token generation in large language models.
why_valuable: Enables faster, more efficient LLM inference with reduced latency and computational costs while maintaining output quality.
